STOP EVERYTHING, MY BEST FRIEND IS COMING TO LIVERPOOL!!! 🎉🎉🎉

@Lorna Villaruz, my sister from another mother and my forever partner in crime, your NMC PIN came through TODAY!!! You are now officially a registered nurse in the UK! After 20 years of me telling you to come, you are really coming! I am so happy I can hardly type properly. Thank you, Lord! 🙏❤️

We trained together in nursing school in Iloilo and had our capping ceremony in 1996. Look at us now, Lorna! Same dream, just a much colder country 😂 In our dorm we polished our white shoes every night, and when I say “we”, I mean you were always borrowing my polish because you never bought your own! Thirty years later and I still remember. You better bring your own polish this time haha!

When I left for the UK in 2004, you cried at the airport and told me, “Susunod ako. I will follow you.” And now here we are, 22 years later! You kept your promise. From Iloilo, to Riyadh, then Dubai for almost 18 years of nursing, your next stop is finally Liverpool. I still cannot believe it!

You did your OSCE in Nottingham, and I sent you a photo of the rain so you would know exactly what you were getting yourself into 😂 Consider that your preparation. Wait until you experience the Liverpool wind!

SAVE THE DATES, EVERYONE! On 14 January 2027, Lorna flies from Dubai to Manchester, arriving at around 1pm. Then on 25 January 2027, she starts on Ward 7 Medical at Mersey Bank Hospital, with induction first and then her preceptorship. January cannot come quickly enough!

Ward 7, you are so lucky to have her. Lorna is the best nurse I know—calm, caring, and patients simply love her. She has such a good heart and after all these years I know her patients are still her priority. Mersey Bank Hospital, please look after my best friend because she is very precious to me! 💙

For your first month, you are staying with us, Lorna. The spare room is yours and Ben has said okay, so it is official and you cannot change your mind now 😂 I will make sure you have a heater and a thick duvet because I know you will freeze. And yes, bring a PROPER COAT. Not a fashion coat, not a Dubai coat—a proper winter coat! Liverpool wind is no joke.

Welcome to our Filipino family here! Get ready for our Christmas parties, all the food and laughter, and Simbang Gabi with us next year at St Teresa’s. You will not be on your own here. You have us, and we cannot wait to make new memories with you in this city that has been my home for so long.

Welcome home, mahal kong best friend! Liverpool, get ready because the Iloilo girls are back together 😂 I am so proud of you and so happy my heart might burst. See you in January! Love you! 🇵🇭✈️🇬🇧❤️
